customManagers.description: CLI tool catalog pins in services/cli_tools.rs (// renovate: datasource=... depName=... above each *_VERSION const)

Slack MCP connector: pinned fork release asset in default_mcp.json. Two match strings because the version appears twice in the URL (release tag and tarball filename) and both must move together. Both capture the version without the leading 'v' (the tarball filename has none); extractVersionTemplate strips the 'v' from the datasource's release tags so they compare against the same form.

packageRules.description: Group each Rust-embedded npm CLI pin into its own PR; auto-merge once tests pass.
prBodyNotes: This dependency is pinned inside Rust source (see `crates/executors/src/executors/*.rs`) and is managed by a Renovate custom manager — do not hand-edit the version.

packageRules.description: CLI tool catalog pins: never auto-merge — bumping a version requires refreshing the matching per-platform sha256 pins in cli_tools.rs, or installs fail (loudly) at checksum verification.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Refresh the sha256 pins:** this version is pinned in `crates/services/src/services/cli_tools.rs` next to per-platform `sha256` hashes. Download the new artifacts, recompute the hashes, and update them in the same PR — a stale hash makes the in-app install fail at verification.

packageRules.description: Slack MCP fork release: never auto-merge — the pinned launcher tarball's sha256 lives in mcp_config.rs and the version is named in the docs, and fork releases are semver prereleases (`-vk.N`) that Renovate would otherwise skip as unstable.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Move all three together:** the release URL in `crates/executors/default_mcp.json`, the `SLACK_MCP_FORK_TAG` / `SLACK_MCP_LAUNCHER_SHA256` constants in `crates/executors/src/mcp_config.rs`, and the version documented in `docs/integrations/mcp-server-configuration.mdx`. Then run `cargo test -p executors slack_pinned_launcher_matches_recorded_digest -- --ignored` to confirm the published asset matches the recorded digest.

packageRules.description: PowerShell Gallery catalog pins (Microsoft.Graph): never auto-merge — there is no sha256 twin to refresh, and the module's dependency closure is resolved live at install time, so a green CI run says little about the payload. Review the SDK release notes.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **No hash pin for this one:** this version is pinned in `crates/services/src/services/cli_tools.rs` and installed from PowerShell Gallery via `Save-PSResource`, which resolves the workload-module dependency closure at install time (recorded in the install manifest). Review the Microsoft.Graph PowerShell release notes before merging.

packageRules.description: Major updates carry risk a green test run can't fully vouch for — require human review.
Claude Code CLI: never auto-merge — a passing test suite cannot detect a model-alias change (this is the failure mode that motivated managing these pins).
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Model alias check:** Bumping `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` can change which model the `opus`, `sonnet`, and `haiku` aliases resolve to. A green CI run does **not** catch this. Glance at the CLI release notes / changelog for model-mapping changes before approving.
